title: TunableOP leaves ROCM_VERSION blank and then cannot load the csv because of this
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

tunable op leaves rocm_version empty.

### Versions

I generate this untuned records first then tune them seperately which works and creates the `tunableop_results0.csv` but if I try to use this later I go into this problem : 

reading tuning results from tunableop_results0.csv
Validator PT_VERSION=2.7.0
Validator ROCBLAS_VERSION=5.0.0.776a9bbd-dirty
Validator ROCM_VERSION=
Validator GCN_ARCH_NAME=gfx1030
Validator HIPBLASLT_VERSION=1500-b0f83de7-dirty
ROCM_VERSION validation: expect  to match

So basically it won't recognize my rocm and then when it reads it back even though it expects "empty" value that causes a problem. I am using https://github.com/lshqqytiger/TheRock/releases/tag/build0 ,so have the hip_sdk_develop folder as rocm(it says 6.5). The tunableop clearly finds and solves the records , it is only because the non-existant version number it can't go further. I tried putting 6 , 6.5 , etc it always expects "nothing" but won't work with empty value either.

cc @jeffdaily @sunway513 @jithunnair-amd @pruthvistony @ROCmSupport @dllehr-amd @jataylo @hongxiayang @naromero77amd
